description: Create a new post collection for the authenticated user. Set type='manual' to hand-curate posts with add_to_collection, or type='smart' with a `config` predicate (e.g. {format:'video',min_likes:50}) to define a dynamic collection resolved on-demand by resolve_collection. Free — costs 0 credits.

config.description: Predicate for smart collections. Supported keys: format, min_likes, min_comments, date_after, date_before, topic_contains, author_profile_id, profile_ids (array — posts whose profile_id is in the set; use to group several tracked profiles/streams into one live collection), source_type. Required when type='smart'.

name: create_collection
title: Create Post Collection
